todo_line: - [ ] 004 Implement and unit-test an app-private provisional binding/source contract for opaque interests, one assign per query, route rebind, relevant refresh, access errors, subscribe-before-read, bind-time reconciliation and reconnect, without a process per query or a frozen package API.

validation.evidence: 7 focused tests passed with 0 failures, covering disconnected and connected binding, owner-process execution, scoped refresh and interest replacement, route rebind, access errors, deterministic bind-window reconciliation, and fresh connected remounts.
All Elixir source and test files are formatted.

notes: The initial TDD run failed before the provisional modules existed. Query now owns one loader/result/interests shape, Source owns subscription plus opaque notification classification/matching, Binding keeps registrations in one reserved socket assign and returns `{query_id, reason}` access errors to the LiveView owner, and the fixture models reconnect as a fresh connected mount/process. Bind-window reconciliation snapshots messages from subscribe through result/interest installation, consumes recognized source notifications, and forces a conservative follow-up read without sleeps; no dashboard wiring, Memba projector mapping, Commanded dependency, package extraction, generic navigation policy, or per-query process was introduced.
